At 175 cm and 72.6 kg: BMI = 72.6 ÷ 1.75: A tsayin 175 cm da nauyin 72.6 kg: BMI = 72.6 ÷ 1.75² ≈ 23.7, BMI Prime ≈ 0.95, kuma Ponderal Index ≈ 13.5 kg/m³. Iyakokin nauyin kwatance su ne 18.5 × 1.75² = 56.65625 kg da 25 × 1.75² = 76.5625 kg; ba a haɗa iyakar sama ba. Bayan zagaye domin nunawa: 56.7–<76.6 kg. Devine is a historical height-and-sex re: Devine wata tsohuwar ma'aunin lissafi ce bisa tsayi da jinsi, wadda ake ambata a rubuce-rubucen ƙayyade adadin magani. Ba ta la'akari da yanayin jiki, shekaru, ciki ko lafiyar mutum. Wannan kayan ilimi na manya ba ya zaɓar nauyin da za a yi amfani da shi wajen ƙayyade magani a asibiti, ba ya lissafa adadin magani, kuma ba ya ƙayyade nauyin lafiya da za a nema.
